articles.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: America is going to the polls, and the results will shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years. Here's what to know.

articles.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
articles.snippet: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.

articles.title: Sherrod Brown's Ohio edge threatens a rough go for crypto next year
articles.snippet: The industry's $63 million question revolves around whether its political adversary in Ohio rides the Trump backlash back into the Senate.

articles.title: Binance $6.3B record hack sparks pre-election political clashes
articles.snippet: Some political and administration figures tried to make hay of the biggest-ever crypto heist.

articles.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
articles.snippet: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.
